Same area (x 0–600, y 41–517) cropped from each published image <code>kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
